anna_cs: Quick heads-up 101 1 launching a lightweight onboarding primer + feedback loop for MeridianHealth next Tue 11:00 PT. Objective: reduce first-50 request failures, capture targeted failure examples, and surface renewal-risk signals.

liam_csm: Proposed short runbook: T-30m spin warmpool "meridian-warm" -> size 3, ramp 0->3 over 12m. T-15m run prefill (8 short sequences). T+0..120m monitor: latency P95, error rate, and slot-fill accuracy. T+24h capture CSAT + top failure prompts.

devon_tse: Add 1 structured eval of 12 prompts (mix: 6 slot-fill, 3 tool-calls, 3 redaction). If semantic failures >= 3% on eval, tag "escalate:product" and open an eval ticket with model logs.

anna_cs: Can someone paste the exact prefill payload? I'll run it from support laptop. @prefill-bot please schedule.

prefill-bot: Prefill template (replace $TOKEN, $TENANT):
```bash
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.redwood-inference/v1/prefill \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{"tenant":"meridian","requests":[{"prompt":"onboard_welcome_v2","count":4},{"prompt":"patient_slot_test","count":4}],"cache_policy":"prefix","kv_ttl":1800,"target_warmpool":"meridian-warm"}'
```
Note: keep sequences <=120 tokens. Stagger bursts with 1-5s jitter.

ops-bot: Warmpool scheduled: id=wp-meridian-279888, start=2025-01-14T18:00:00Z, target=3, ramp_minutes=12. Prefill job queued: id=pf-2798881234-1.

liam_csm: Renewal-risk heuristics to surface to AMs: (A) 24h CSAT <= 6; (B) unique failing prompts >= 4; (C) slot-fill partial completions >= 5% over first 2h; (D) fallback routing triggered. If any true, add tag "renewal-watch" and schedule AM sync within 36h.

devon_tse: Technical fallbacks: 1) If latency P95 > 350ms for 5m -> route to small-quantized and scale warmpool to 0. 2) If error-rate > 4% -> enable conservative token cap (max_tokens=150) and re-run eval. 3) If cost > forecast+60% -> immediate scale down and pause warm-prefill.

anna_cs: Feedback capture plan: short form link in coachmark with fields: 1) Did it do what you expected? (yes/no), 2) If no, paste failing input, 3) severity (low/med/high), 4) email opt-in. Also add one-click "Request AM help" CTA. Keep it <6 fields.

cs-qa: For post-prefill validation: run eval set and collect diffs. If any model regression on slot-fill examples vs baseline > 2% absolute, open a regression ticket and annotate model hash + kv-hit-rate.

liam_csm: Ops tip: prefill bursts should avoid hitting single-host scheduler; randomized inter-request delay 100-700ms across clients and rotate user ids to spread KV keys.

anna_cs: I'll run prefill at 10:00 PT tomorrow and paste the job output here. Will also post coachmark copy for a quick review. If we hit renewal-risk flags I'll loop AMs and product.

prefill-bot: Prefill job started: job_id=pf-2798881234-1, status=running.

anna_cs: Thx team :raised_hands: will update with results + eval diffs in this thread.
